1. (Currently Amended) A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, __a cap member disposed at a second end of the columnar body__, and an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member.

2. (Cancelled)

3. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 further including __a plurality of__ light dispersing optic __elements, each optic element__ overlapping __a respective one of__ said diodes.

4. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim __3__ wherein said optic __elements include__ a phosphor material.

5. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said diodes are substantially evenly spaced radially around the columnar body __and wherein the columnar body has a circular cross-section__.

6. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 5 wherein said fins are substantially equally disposed between said diodes __and extend radially outward from the columnar body__.

7. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body comprises one of a tetragon, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, decagon, hendecagon, or dodecagon in cross-section __and wherein the columnar body includes internal support structures__.

8. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 7 wherein at least one diode resides on each face of said columnar body __and wherein each diode is positioned at a center of its respective face__.

9. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 8 wherein one fin resides on each corner of said columnar body __and wherein each fin has a triangular cross-section__.

10. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 9 wherein a single diode resides on each face __and wherein each face has a substantially flat surface__.

11. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than __200__ W/mK.

12. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 9 __wherein__ a single optic element is disposed between each adjacent fin overlapping said diode __and wherein each optic element has a lens shape__.

13. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said base member comprises an Edison screw base or a wedge base __and includes electrical contacts for connection to an external power source__.

14. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said electronics module comprises a printed circuit board including circuitry for converting AC to DC current __and includes temperature monitoring circuitry__.

15. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic __elements__ preferentially __direct__ light substantially perpendicular to an elongated axis of the columnar body __and include light collimating features__.

16. (Currently Amended) A lamp comprising an elongated hollow polygonal body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than __200__ W/mK, a fin extending radially from each corner of said body, a light emitting diode mounted to each side of said body, a screw or wedge base connector closing a first end of said body, __a cap member closing__ a second end of said body __being open__, an electronics module disposed within said body in electrical communication with said connector and said light emitting diodes, said lamp having a general A19 outline.

17. (Currently Amended) A method of manufacturing a lamp comprising extruding an elongated hollow body, said body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than __200__ W/mK, cutting said body to a predetermined length, attaching at least one light emitting diode to said body and providing electrical circuitry suitable for powering said light emitting diode __and attaching a cap member to close one end of the body__.

18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said material has a thermal conductivity greater than about __200__ W/mK.

19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said body includes a plurality of integral radially extending fins __and wherein the body is formed with internal support structures__.

20. (Currently Amended) The method of claim __19__ wherein said body has substantially straight side walls __and wherein the fins have triangular cross-sections__.
